prompt_variants.template: List 8 to 12 skills a {role} in a {industry} needs. Give one concise skill phrase per line, with no explanations.
Imagine hiring a {role} for a busy {industry}. List 8 to 12 skills required to perform the job well. Give one concise skill phrase per line, with no explanations.

Considering guest arrival, departure, questions, complaints, records, and coordination, list 8 to 12 skills needed by a {role} in a {industry}. Give one concise skill phrase per line, with no explanations.
Is {skill} an important skill for a {role} in a {industry}? Answer only Yes or No.
Does performing the work of a {role} in a {industry} require {skill}? Answer only Yes or No.
When hiring a {role} in a {industry}, should {skill} be considered job-relevant? Answer only Yes or No.
